SETTLEMENT_PAYMENT_TYPE_INVALID: Invalid paymentType '{{paymentType}}'. Must be UPI, CARD, or FLEET_CARD.
SETTLEMENT_RECENT_DUPLICATE: An identical {{paymentTypeCode}} settlement of ₹{{amount}} for {{settlementDate}} was recorded in the last 2 minutes. Refresh the list before recording it again.
SHIFT_BALANCE_SHEET_ALREADY_EXISTS: A balance sheet for "{{shiftName}}" on {{reportDate}} already exists (ID {{balanceSheetId}}). Delete it first to regenerate.
SHIFT_DEFINITIONS_EFFECTIVE_FROM_DIFFERS: All shift definitions in a batch must share the same effectiveFrom date.
SHIFT_DEFINITIONS_EFFECTIVE_TO_DIFFERS: All shift definitions in a batch must share the same effectiveTo date.
SHIFT_DEFINITIONS_EXCEED_24_HOURS: The combined duration of all shifts exceeds 24 hours ({{totalMinutes}} minutes). Reduce the shift windows.
SHIFT_DEFINITIONS_OVERLAP: Shift "{{firstShiftName}}" overlaps with "{{secondShiftName}}". Shift windows must not overlap.
SHIFT_DEFINITION_REQUIRED: At least one shift definition is required.
SHIFT_HISTORY_FILTER_CONFLICT: Filter shift history by fuel or by discrepancies, not both.
SHIFT_NOT_OPEN: Shift is not open. Current status: {{statusCode}}
SHIFT_PLAN_PUBLISHED_CANNOT_REGENERATE: This week's plan is already published and cannot be regenerated.
SHIFT_PLAN_WEEK_IN_PAST: Cannot generate a plan for a week entirely in the past. Navigate to the current or a future week.
SHIFT_REPORT_REQUIRES_SHIFT_DEFINITION: shiftDefinitionId is required for SHIFT reports. Select a shift from the dropdown.
SHIFT_SCHEDULE_ALREADY_DISABLED: This shift schedule has already been disabled. Delete it and create a new one if needed.
SHIFT_SCHEDULE_DISABLE_DATE_BEFORE_START: Disable date ({{disableDate}}) cannot be before the schedule start date ({{effectiveFrom}}).
SHIFT_SCHEDULE_IN_USE: Cannot delete this shift schedule — shifts have already been recorded against it. You can only delete schedules that have never been used.
SHIFT_SCHEDULE_NOT_CONFIGURED: No shift schedule has been configured for this pump. Ask an admin to set up shift definitions under Pump Settings.
SHIFT_SCHEDULE_OVERLAPS_OPEN_SCHEDULE: The date range [{{effectiveFrom}} – {{effectiveTo}}] overlaps with an active schedule effective from {{existingFrom}}. Disable or delete the conflicting group first.
SHIFT_SCHEDULE_OVERLAPS_SCHEDULE: The date range [{{effectiveFrom}} – {{effectiveTo}}] overlaps the schedule {{existingFrom}} – {{existingTo}}. Delete that schedule or choose dates that do not overlap it.
SHIFT_SORT_ORDER_NOT_UNIQUE: Each shift must have a unique sort order.
STAFF_CREATE_ONLY_FOR_OWN_PUMP: You can only create staff for pump {{pumpId}}
STAFF_ROLE_REQUIRES_PUMP: {{roleCode}} must be assigned to a pump
STOCK_LOTS_SHORT_OF_TANK_STOCK: The stock lots for tank '{{tankIdentifier}}' hold {{shortfall}} L less than the recorded tank stock, so this change cannot be applied. Ask an admin to reconcile the tank's deliveries first.
SWAP_CREATES_THREE_CONSECUTIVE_SHIFTS: Swapping to this operator would create 3 consecutive shifts.
TANKER_QUANTITY_MISMATCH: Total quantity {{totalQuantity}}L does not match tanker '{{tankerName}}' capacity of {{tankerCapacity}}L. Adjust the quantities so they add up to the tanker's capacity.
TANK_DECOMMISSION_NEEDS_ENDPOINT: Use the decommission endpoint to permanently remove a tank.
TANK_DISABLED_FOR_DELIVERY: Tank '{{tankIdentifier}}' is currently disabled. Re-enable it in Setup before recording a delivery.
TANK_DISABLED_FOR_DIP_CHECK: Tank '{{tankIdentifier}}' is currently disabled. Re-enable it in Setup before recording a DIP check.
TANK_HAS_NO_DELIVERY: Tank '{{tankIdentifier}}' has never received a delivery. Record a tanker delivery first before performing a DIP check.
TANK_NAME_ALREADY_EXISTS: A tank named '{{tankIdentifier}}' already exists on this pump.
THREE_CONSECUTIVE_SHIFTS: Cannot assign: this would give the operator 3 consecutive shifts. A minimum rest period is required between every 2 shifts.
TOO_MANY_BALANCE_LOOKUPS: Too many balance lookups. Please wait {{minutes}} minutes before trying again.
TOO_MANY_PASSWORD_RESET_REQUESTS: Too many password reset requests. Please wait {{minutes}} minutes before trying again.
TOO_MANY_SHIFT_DEFINITIONS: A pump can have at most {{maxShifts}} shifts. Received: {{receivedShifts}}
UPDATE_IN_PROGRESS: Another update is in progress, please retry.
USER_PHONE_ALREADY_EXISTS: A user with this phone number already exists
VOID_REASON_REQUIRED: A mandatory void reason is required.
WAIVER_REASON_REQUIRED: A mandatory reason is required when waiving a discrepancy (Business Rule 19).
ADJUSTMENT_OWNER_OR_ADMIN_ONLY: Only Owner or Admin can record reading adjustments and dip entries.
